description: This is a code-behind C# source file for the Leaderboard page in an ASP.NET Web Forms application. It handles page load events to retrieve user info from session and database, and provides navigation via button click handlers.

classes.name: Leaderboard
classes.description: Code-behind class for the Leaderboard page, managing user session, database connection, and navigation.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles the initial loading of the page, retrieves user semester info based on session ID, or redirects to login if not logged in.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Handles navigation to the dashboard page.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Handles navigation to the user profile page.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
